name: REST Countries
tagline: Free country metadata API for names, capitals, currencies, borders, and flags
description: Public REST API that returns structured country data including names, ISO codes, capitals, currencies, languages, borders, regions, population, timezones, and flag assets. Designed for apps that need country pickers, trip/visa context, currency labels, or regional filters without maintaining a local dataset. Version 3.1 is the current public surface; no authentication is required for typical read access.

auth.details: No authentication required for public read endpoints; requests work without API keys or OAuth.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free for non-commercial use; commercial use requires a paid plan (exact free quotas not published as numbered req/day)
pricing.paid_plans: Commercial license/plan available via the project site; exact tiers and prices not fully public as standard SaaS tiers

use_cases: get capital and currency for a country by name
list countries by region for a trip planner filter
resolve ISO country code to borders and neighboring countries
fetch flag and demonym metadata for visa or travel UI labels
search countries by currency code for multi-currency trip apps
